en.name: Norinco Type 97 NSR Gen 3 (5.56x45mm)
en.description:
The Type 97 is a semi-automatic, magazine fed, gas operated bullpup. It is the civilian version of the QBZ-95, the standard issue rifle for the Peoples Liberation Army. The bullpup design allows it to retain an 18.6″ barrel length in a relatively compact package, allowing for better maneuverability in tight spaces and less fatigue to the shooter without sacrificing velocity and reach.

The NSR G3 version features an M-Lok front handguard, flip up sights and full top rail. The NSR G3 also has an ambidextrous magazine release, non reciprocating side charging handle that is reversible.

en.name: Norinco Type 97 5.56x45 18.7 inch barrel
en.description: An 18.6 inch barrel, which meets non-restricted requirements in Canada. Has a twist rate of 1:7 and can fire 5.56x45mm NATO as well as .223 Remington. This one has had the muzzle device removed by a local gunsmith.

en.name: Jianshe Industries QBZ-97 5.56x45 11.5 inch barrel
en.description: A QBZ-97B carbine length barrel manufactured by Norinco but sold by Jianshe Industries Corporation internationally under the name "Type NQZ03B (97)"

en.name: Norinco QBZ-95-1 Upper Receiver
en.description: The QBZ-95-1, also called the QBZ-95 "Gai" ("改"; literally: 'modified'), addresses several reliability and ease-of-use issues, and has improved ergonomics. The carry handle has retained the Chinese quick release mount rail.

en.name: QBZ-95-1 Assaulter Upper
en.description: The QBZ-95-1 "Assaulter" (突击者) upgrade kit is extremely rare and is worth many times the price of the base rifle. Using machined aluminum, this allows for the attachment of sights and light/lasers

en.name: QBZ-95-1 Assaulter Upper (PLA Camo)
en.description: The QBZ-95-1 "Assaulter" (突击者) upgrade kit is extremely rare and is worth many times the price of the base rifle. Using machined aluminum, this allows for the attachment of sights and light/lasers. This one is even more rare, with a cerakoted PLA camo pattern.

en.name: T97.ca Type 97 Flat Top Upper Receiver
en.description: The new T97NSR FTU™ (Flat Top Upper) is a CNC machined, 6061 alloy, 1913 Picatinny optics rail, firearms accessories mounting platform and protective hand guard. It was produced by the product developers at M14.ca, the OEM of the M14.ca Blackfeather "RS" rifle stock and the M14.ca CASM™ scope mount series, under the new web site: www.T97.ca. The T97.ca FTU™ is the first in a series of planned upgrades for the Norinco T97NSR bullpup rifle. The FTU™ replaces the T97NSR's factory iron sights, original plastic hand guard as well as adding the option to mount sights and tactical accessories, changing the operational dynamics of the original rifle.

en.name: Norinco Type 97 Gen 3 Flat Upper Receiver
en.description: The Gen 3 upper introduced a flat picatinny rail for optics and accessories, as well as 3 o'clock and 9 o'clock M-LOK slots for additional accessories.

en.name: Norinco QBZ-95-1 Handguard/Grip
en.description: The QBZ-95-1, also called the QBZ-95 "Gai" ("改"; literally: 'modified'), addresses several reliability and ease-of-use issues, and has improved ergonomics. The "1" variant has an altered butt stock, trigger guard, and a repositioned thumb fire selector switch above the pistol grip.

en.name: Far East Tactical QBZ-95-1 Longbow Handguard/Grip
en.description: Launched in 2007, the Real Sword Type-97 was produced to bring in a new and exotic design to the airsoft community. The RS Type-97 is based off the QBZ-97, an export version of the PLA QBZ-95. In the decade plus since the initial launch, the QBZ platform has undergone several changes – including rail upgrades, the Canadian FTU project, as well as the QBZ-95-1 iteration in the Chinese military. Meanwhile, aftermarket support for the Type-97 remains non-existent. To fill in this gap in the airsoft community, Far East Tactical has teamed up with Serika Arms to create PROJECT: LONG BOW.

en.name: T97.ca Type 97 Lower Handguard
en.description:
The T97.ca Lower Hand Guard (LHG) is a 6061-T6 aluminum component replacement for the T97NSR bullpup rifle's plastic lower (compatible with GEN I, II and III T97NSRs). It was designed by the product developers at M14.ca, a retired Canadian Forces military officer, former gunsmith, and two expert CNC machinists. The LHG is a complex group of components designed to enhance the non-restricted T97NSR bullpup rifle and eliminate multiple shortcomings inherent to the original design.

     The LHG is CNC machined from a solid block of aluminum and it offers the end user a light weight, tight fitting lower housing with skeletonized fore end and improved trigger area contours for enhanced ergonomics. It features new trigger group components that deliver a 50% reduction in trigger travel and a pull weight of approx. 4lbs. for smooth, fast and more precise followup shots. It ships with a new aluminum "T-cut" lightened trigger and an ambidextrous trigger blocking device similar to the AR15 safety (marked accordingly and useable by the support hand thumb). It adds an interchangeable/removable "Standard Trigger Guard" or "STG" and AR15 pistol grip compatiblity (pistol grip not included). Finally, it ships with an improved magazine release button.
